title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

already_open.description: True when it was already open in a window; it was made active and not opened again. A document loaded only because an open assembly uses it is opened in a window of its own, and this is false.

read_only.description: True when it is open read-only.

warnings.description: What SOLIDWORKS warned about while opening it (swFileLoadWarning_e names), for example swFileLoadWarning_ModelOutOfDate.

missing.description: Files the document uses (an assembly's components, a drawing's models) that SOLIDWORKS could not find; those components stay suppressed, and those views show nothing. Empty when nothing is missing.

items.description: A component file SOLIDWORKS loaded in place of the one an assembly names.

expected.description: The full path the assembly stores for it.

loaded.description: The full path of the same-named file SOLIDWORKS loaded instead.

substituted.description: An assembly's component files (or a drawing's model files) SOLIDWORKS loaded from another folder than the document says, because the file was not there: check each is the file meant before saving the document, which would then point at it. Empty when nothing was substituted.
